notes: Views in the lowest_kept are English Wikipedia 12-month views (0 where no article or the candidate is a listing-only place). Every left-out candidate above 1000 views or two counted sources is listed with its concrete 'What qualifies' reason: all are non-visitor institutions (school, university, hotel, venue), part of a kept spot, a long linear feature covered by a kept spot, or single non-counted-source reviews.
